premise: A betrayed noblewoman marries a mysterious scarred duke to escape her family's cruelty, only to face a deadly conspiracy that threatens to tear them apart.

characters.name: Juliana
characters.who: Betrayed noblewoman who marries a stranger for dignity

characters.name: Alexander
characters.who: Scarred, exiled duke seeking to reclaim his title and protect his wife

characters.name: Catherine
characters.who: Villainous noblewoman plotting to destroy the new duchess

characters.name: Rupert
characters.who: Treacherous nobleman conspiring with Catherine to seize the ducal seat

characters.name: Dowager Duchess
characters.who: Sickly matriarch whose poisoning sets the central conflict in motion

characters.name: Prudence
characters.who: Loyal ally who helps Juliana infiltrate the manor

characters.name: Gerald
characters.who: Juliana's cowardly ex-fiancé who abandoned her at the altar

characters.name: Clarissa
characters.who: Juliana's cruel sister who aided in her betrayal

characters.name: Father Thomas
characters.who: Corrupt clergyman who aids Catherine's schemes

characters.name: Alexander's Mother

characters.name: Crown Official
